prompt: Image 1 is a satellite image before an event; image 2 shows the same area afterward. Write a change caption in English using 2 or 3 sentences, about 40 to 70 words. Focus only on observable changes in buildings, roads, vegetation, water or ground. Do not inventory unchanged features. Avoid repeating claims and do not infer repairs, causes, location, disaster type, casualties or structural safety without clear visual evidence. If changes cannot be determined, say so briefly. Return only the caption.
